CRLR No.346 of 2018 
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
 Mr. Mani Kumar, Advocate for the 
revisionist. 
 Mr. Sandeep Tandon, Deputy 
Advocate General alongwith Ms. Shivangi 
Gangwar, Brief Holder for the State. 
 This criminal revision is directed 
against the judgment and order dated 
19.07.2018 passed by Judge, Family 
Court, Udham Singh Nagar, in criminal 
misc. case no.120/2012, whereby said 
court has partly allowed the application 
moved by the revisionist u/s 125 of 
Cr.P.C. and has directed the respondent 
no.2 to pay maintenance @ ` 4,000/- per 
month in favour of the revisionist by the 
10th of each month, from the date of 
order i.e. 19.07.2018. 
 Heard. 
 Admit. 
 Issue notice to respondent no.2, 
fixing 07.12.2018. 
 
 (Lok Pal Singh, J.) 
 24.10.2018
Rajni
